verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an accounting SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a user-definable rule or trigger-action engine. Automatic booking-category suggestions, automatic reference propagation and asset recognition are fixed built-in behaviors, not user-defined rules. The REST API and partner integrations are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
